summary: Test audit of the whole Kiln Build Preflight PRD at a9d64fe graded the 10 criteria in force. AC-ATTEND-01, -03 and -04 are Adequate, and a red check on each turned its test red. Seven criteria are Weak: AC-PREFLIGHT-08, -01, -03, -02, -06, -05 and AC-ATTEND-05. The main gaps are the Folder missing Start paths, Documents found placement of the Preflight row, a finished preflight's session detail, the worktree-unchanged proof, the Codex no-skill case and the early-merge warning's visual separation. None is high risk and none is a delivery gap. The gaps and fixes are recorded in test-audit.md for the fixing sessions.
